extract_tss: extract transcription start sites from a GTF DataFrame as zero-width point intervals
filter_transcript_type: filter GTF entries to only rows matching specified transcript types like protein_coding or lncRNA
filter_protein_coding: filter GTF entries to only protein-coding genes with optional gene entry inclusion
filter_to_longest_transcript: filter GTF entries to keep only the longest transcript per gene by genomic length
get_gene_intervals: get a list of stranded genome intervals for given gene symbols or Ensembl gene IDs
